name: Enterprise workspace and overview
summary: The company-level workspace (Overview, Projects, Regions, User Management, Captures, Notes, Activities) and its overview counts. Who may act as an enterprise admin is defined in USER-FEAT-07; this feature covers what the workspace shows and who can reach it.

requirements.title: Enterprise admins get one company-level workspace
requirements.statement: Enterprise admins have a company-level workspace with an overview, projects, regions, user management, captures, notes and activities across the company's projects. It shows project health and helps them manage users across projects.
requirements.rationale: The PRD also asks for automated insights on project issues. No insight engine was found in the enterprise code, so that part is PRD-only.

requirements.title: How the overview counts users and projects
requirements.statement: Today the overview counts active, verified users assigned to the company's projects, in the company and its linked companies. A user is active if they have any activity in the last 24 hours. New users are those created since Monday. A project is active if it is live, approved, and has a capture since the Monday two weeks before the current week.

requirements.title: Admins see every invited user across projects
requirements.statement: In user management, admins see all invited users at company and project level, with a Projects column listing the projects each user is invited to. Invitation rules themselves are USER-REQ-045.

requirements.title: Admins of several companies can switch between them
requirements.statement: A super-admin or regional admin who administers more than one company (for example a parent and a subsidiary) can switch the workspace between those companies, even when their email domain belongs to only one of them.

requirements.title: Only Track3D support turns the enterprise tier on or off
requirements.statement: Today a company becomes an enterprise company through a flag that only Track3D support users can set or clear. Company profile updates and deletion are also limited to support users.
